map.等效焦距计算器求不同画幅下的等效焦距，以全画幅为基准系数 1，方便跨机位视角统一: The equivalent focal length calculator converts focal length across formats using full frame as the factor 1 baseline, making cross-format view comparison and lens range selection easier.
map.等效焦距 = 实际焦距 × 裁切系数: Equivalent focal length = actual focal length x crop factor
map.对比两镜头等效焦距的取景差异。: Compare the framing differences between two lenses at equivalent focal lengths.
map.换镜头前预估构图变化。: Estimate the framing change before changing lenses.
map.：35mm 与 50mm：视角变化比 = 50/35 ≈ 1.43，50mm 比: 35mm and 50mm: the angle-of-view ratio = 50/35 = about 1.43, so 50mm frames about 1.4x tighter than 35mm and the subject looks larger; a wide lens conversely holds more.
map.：全幅 50mm 在 APS-C 等效 75mm：视角变窄如长焦，需退更远才容纳: A 50mm on full frame equals 75mm on APS-C: the view narrows like a telephoto, so you need to step back further to hold the same framing.
map.视角变化比怎么算？: How is the angle-of-view ratio computed?
map.近似为焦距比（视角非严格线性但近），长焦/短焦比即取景缩放倍率。: Roughly the focal length ratio (the relation to angle of view is not strictly linear but close); the long/short focal length ratio is the framing zoom factor.
map.等效影响透视吗？: Does the equivalent focal length affect perspective?
map.不影响，透视由物距决定；等效只改视角范围，压缩感取决于你站多远。: No, perspective is determined by subject distance; equivalent focal length only changes the angle of view range, and the compression feel depends on how far away you stand.
